mapper.insert: INSERT INTO route_design_request (booking_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_type) VALUES (#{bookingId}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{cargoType})
mapper.select: SELECT booking_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_type, status, requested_at FROM route_design_request WHERE booking_id = #{bookingId}
SELECT booking_id, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, cargo_type, status, requested_at FROM route_design_request ORDER BY requested_at DESC
